questions.q: What is the central organizing idea of this capstone?
options: Twenty-five unrelated exercises, one per Oracle Fusion module
One fictional company carried continuously through design, operation, and a month-end crisis
A multiple-choice review of every prior course in the path
A single Payables-only simulation
questions.explain: The capstone follows one company, LTV Manufacturing Corporation, end to end across configuration, transactions, and a real crisis — not disconnected drills.

questions.q: Which chapter is described as the centerpiece of this capstone?
options: Chapter 4, Wrap-Up
Chapter 1, Design and Configuration
Chapter 3, The January 31 Challenge
Chapter 2, Running the Business
questions.explain: Chapter 3 is where the CFO's January 31 call sets up the investigation and correction work that the whole capstone builds toward.

questions.q: Why does the lesson warn against skipping straight to Chapter 3?
options: Chapter 3 requires a different fictional company
The Chapter 3 problems are planted inside the specific configuration and transactions built in Chapters 1 and 2
Chapter 3 has no connection to the rest of the course
Chapter 3 only covers quiz questions, not hands-on work
questions.explain: The investigation in Chapter 3 depends on account numbers, suppliers, and transactions set up earlier — it isn't a stand-alone exercise.

questions.q: What should you start keeping from lesson 2 onward, according to this lesson?
options: A Stripe billing record
A running requirements/notes document
A separate Oracle Fusion tenant for every lesson
A spreadsheet of unrelated practice scenarios
questions.explain: The lesson recommends starting a running notes/requirements document in lesson 2 and adding to it through most of the capstone.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT listed as part of what 'done' looks like at lesson 25?
options: A corrected and reconciled month-end close
A complete enterprise structure and chart of accounts
A brand-new, unrelated fictional company for the final presentation
A deliverables package including an Issue Log and Implementation Documentation
questions.explain: Everything in the capstone, including the final presentation, still uses the same LTV Manufacturing Corporation built from lesson 1 onward.
